title: Layers of cause: user, application, system, network and hardware

videos.script: The same sentence, I can't save my file, can come from five different places. {{sentence}} From the person, who is saving to the wrong folder. From the program. From the system, which refuses. From the network, when the folder lives on another machine. Or from a disk that is failing. {{five}} This lesson walks one real case down those five layers, one check each, until one of them answers. {{walk}} And it shows something that happens to everyone: a first fix that fails for the very reason it was needed. {{fails}}
